name: advisor-hero
title: Advisor hero
description: A person-led opening for a consultant or lawyer: portrait, credentials, one line of promise and a link to book a first call.
docs: The portrait needs a real alt text. nextSlot is optional and renders as text with a time element, so pass dateTime as an ISO moment and label as the words ("Thursday 10:00"). availability is the small status pill over the portrait. The page asks for one thing, cta; phone is a quiet link beside it, never a second button. A longer cta label, in another language, wraps to a second line instead of being cut off.
